name: dmbridge
description: A provider-neutral JSON CLI for direct messages.

scripts.clean: node --input-type=module -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.clean:metadata: node --input-type=module -e "import { readdirSync, rmSync } from 'node:fs'; const directories = ['dist']; for (const directory of directories) for (const entry of readdirSync(directory, { withFileTypes: true })) { const path = directory + '/' + entry.name; if (entry.name.startsWith('._')) rmSync(path, { recursive: true, force: true }); else if (entry.isDirectory()) directories.push(path) }"
scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && npm run clean:metadata
scripts.test:compile: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.json && npm run clean:metadata
scripts.test:live: npm run test:compile && DMBRIDGE_READONLY_LIVE=1 node --test dist/test/live/*.test.js
